description:
Title: Luxury Airplane

You produce airplanes.
While the base model is always the same, your customer likes to pimp their airplane with fancy interior.
You let them decide between a number of 5 different bars, the number of seats, their color, and the amount of water in the toilets of their plane (you can come up with additional stuff).
After you received the specifications you send the requirements to different teams to manufacture the parts.
E.g. manufacturing the vodka bar is done by the Russian team, the whiskey bar is manufactured by an Irish team.
After receiving the individual bits and pieces, the interior of the plane is assembled, and the plane is sent on a test flight.
During the flight you create a test protocol which is sent to you and the customer.
The plane is delivered to the customer, which has to confirm.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_LuxuryAirplane" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/luxury-airplane">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerSpecifications" name="Customer specifications"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RequirementsRussianTeam" name="Requirements for vodka bar"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RequirementsIrishTeam" name="Requirements for whiskey bar"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartsRussianTeam" name="Vodka bar parts"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartsIrishTeam" name="Whiskey bar parts"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Delivery confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LuxuryAirplane">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Manufacturer" name="Airplane Manufacturer" processRef="Process_AirplaneManufacturer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PartnerTeams" name="Partner Manufacturing Teams"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Specifications" name="Specifications" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_SpecificationsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RequirementsRussianTeam" name="Requirements" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirementsRussianTeam" targetRef="Participant_PartnerTeams"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RequirementsIrishTeam" name="Requirements" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirementsIrishTeam" targetRef="Participant_PartnerTeams"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PartsRussianTeam" name="Vodka bar parts" sourceRef="Participant_PartnerTeams" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_PartsRussianTeam"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PartsIrishTeam" name="Whiskey bar parts" sourceRef="Participant_PartnerTeams" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_PartsIrishTeam"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol" sourceRef="SendTask_SendTestProtocol" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Delivery confirmation" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_DeliveryConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_AirplaneManufacturer" name="Airplane Manufacturer Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SpecificationsReceived" name="Customer specifications received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Specifications" messageRef="Message_CustomerSpecifications"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordSpecifications" name="Record customer specifications (5 bars, seats, color, toilet water, additional options)"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendRequirementsRussianTeam" name="Send requirements to Russian team (vodka bar)" messageRef="Message_RequirementsRussianTeam"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendRequirementsIrishTeam" name="Send requirements to Irish team (whiskey bar)" messageRef="Message_RequirementsIrishTeam"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PartsSplit" name="Parts awaited"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_PartsRussianTeam" name="Vodka bar parts received from Russian team">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PartsRussianTeam" messageRef="Message_PartsRussianTeam"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_PartsIrishTeam" name="Whiskey bar parts received from Irish team">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PartsIrishTeam" messageRef="Message_PartsIrishTeam"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PartsJoin" name="All parts received"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble plane interior"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FlightSplit" name="Test flight started"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductTestFlight" name="Conduct test flight"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateTestProtocol" name="Create test protocol during flight"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FlightJoin" name="Flight and protocol completed"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendTestProtocol" name="Send test protocol to customer" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_DeliverAirplane" name="Deliver airplane to customer"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_DeliveryConfirmed" name="Customer confirms delivery">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DeliveryConfirmed" messageRef="Message_DeliveryConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DeliveryConfirmed" name="Delivery confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_SpecificationsReceived" targetRef="Task_RecordSpecifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_2" sourceRef="Task_RecordSpecifications" targetRef="SendTask_SendRequirementsRussianTeam"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_3" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirementsRussianTeam" targetRef="SendTask_SendRequirementsIrishTeam"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_4" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirementsIrishTeam" targetRef="Gateway_PartsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsSplit" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_PartsRussianTeam"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsSplit" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_PartsIrishTeam"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_7" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_PartsRussianTeam" targetRef="Gateway_PartsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_8" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_PartsIrishTeam" targetRef="Gateway_PartsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsJoin" targetRef="Task_AssembleInterior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_10" sourceRef="Task_AssembleInterior" targetRef="Gateway_FlightSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_FlightSplit" targetRef="Task_ConductTestFlight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_FlightSplit" targetRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_13" sourceRef="Task_ConductTestFlight" targetRef="Gateway_FlightJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_14" sourceRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol" targetRef="Gateway_FlightJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_FlightJoin" targetRef="SendTask_SendTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_16" sourceRef="SendTask_SendTestProtocol" targetRef="ManualTask_DeliverAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_17" sourceRef="ManualTask_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_DeliveryConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_18" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_DeliveryConfirmed" targetRef="EndEvent_DeliveryConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
